_comment: Whether a warm pool's accounting lets its Profile be ready. This file owns the rule. Three implementations run it as a table test: warmPoolOwnsTarget in apps/runtime/internal/firecracker/warm_pool.go (the runtime's healthy flag), warmPoolOwnsTarget in apps/action-runner-agent/readiness.ts (the Worker's readiness check) and in packages/backend/convex/isolation.ts (the control plane's check of a ready report). A pool is ready when it owns exactly its target (parked + claimed = target). It is also ready while it drains toward a lowered target: every guest is claimed, none is parked, and each finished Attempt shrinks the pool (ADR 0003). A pool short of its target is not ready, and neither is one above its target that still holds a parked guest. A recorded pool error is separate: the runtime reports it as healthy=false whatever the counts say.
